name: B10-0246/2025 – After § 21 – Am 23/1
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the old challenges and new commercial practices in the internal market
part_text: 21a. Stresses that the implementation of the DSA must fully respect freedom of expression; underlines that actions against illegal content must not restrict lawful speech and calls for proportionate and transparent enforcement to protect an open and democratic digital space;
